data.name: AIONix Server edition

introduced.event_name: NCC 1981 — Logix networking / Artemis PRO launch

data.api_compatibility: Retains the base platform C/TUI API; optional networking services are discovered through versioned capability checks.
data.delivery: Complete system ROM/EEPROM cartridge image, including the base AIONix services and networking; not an incremental upgrade.
data.description: Separate AIONix edition for networked Artemis and Artemis PRO systems. Includes the base operating system, TCP/IP and server-service interfaces. BPI server applications are separately licensed offerings.
data.edition_relationship: Complete edition of the AIONix family; no prior base-OS installation is required.
features: TCP/IP networking support for Logix LAN
Base AIONix process, file, device and TUI services
Network service lifecycle and server administration interfaces
data.feature_status: Server-service interfaces are part of the edition specification; implementation remains to be validated. Inclusion of an OS edition does not include a BPI application license.

network_link_policy.driver_contract: Enforce host rate ceilings, report advertised and negotiated rates separately, process packet-level interrupts and receiver credits, and expose fallback/error diagnostics. TCP/IP application throughput is below shared raw line rate and requires measurement.

dated_revisions.note: OS facilities included by default; Team Edition repository and collaboration applications licensed separately as one package.
